title: Indigo Hand Block Print Kota Doria Kurta Set with Printed Cotton Pants & Dupatta
color_custom: Indigo blue with off-white hand block print
description:
Deep indigo, crisp kota doria and hand block printed motifs – this is one of our most-loved designs, and it is easy to see why. A light, airy kurta in pure kota doria, printed by hand with a delicate floral buti, paired with dabu-style discharge printed cotton pants and a matching kota doria dupatta finished with a fine zari border and tassels. Effortless for work, brunch, pujas and summer gatherings, and the kind of set you will reach for again and again.

✦ The Details
• Straight kurta in pure kota doria with a square neckline and side slits, calf length
• Indigo hand block print with an all-over floral buti
• Full-length sheer kota doria sleeves
• Matching hand block printed cotton pants (discharge print) with an elastic back waist and side pocket
• Kota doria dupatta with a block printed border, fine zari edge and tassels
• 3-piece set: kurta, pants and dupatta

✦ Fabric & Craft
Kota doria is a featherlight handloom fabric from Rajasthan, known for its signature checked weave (khat) that lets air move freely – perfect for warm days. The kurta has a soft cotton lining, so it stays comfortable and is not see-through, while the sleeves are left sheer for a graceful look. Every piece is printed by hand with wooden blocks by karigars in Jaipur, so small variations in the print are part of its handmade character. The pants are cotton, printed by hand using the discharge technique, where the light motifs are created on an indigo base.

✦ Fit & Size
Regular, straight fit. Choose your usual size or use our Fit Finder. Between sizes? Size up – or send us your bust, waist and hip and we will stitch it to your measurements.

✦ How to Style It
Oxidised silver jhumkas and brown leather juttis for a classic Jaipur look. For the office, skip the dupatta and add a structured tote and a watch. For a puja or festive lunch, drape the dupatta on both shoulders and add a small potli. In cooler weather abroad, a camel or white long coat looks beautiful over indigo.

✦ The Bahe Promise
• Made in Jaipur – we send you photos of your piece before it ships
• Free custom fit on request – share your measurements
• Free worldwide shipping to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE & Australia, with tracking
• Real people on WhatsApp to help with size and styling

Indigo dyes may release a little colour in the first few washes – wash separately in cold water. The colour may look slightly different on your screen.
set_items: Straight Kurta (pure kota doria with cotton lining, hand block print)
Dupatta (kota doria, zari border with tassels)
care: Gentle hand wash separately in cold water or dry clean. Do not wring or soak for long. Dry in shade. Iron on low heat from the reverse.
